about: Every pet program in Astra’s PetOS, numbered for good (docs/naming-20261013.md). Each mini-descriptor is one or two sentences on what the pet program actually does, shown in its repo, the profile README and the System Map. Astra marks each one reviewed. Compiled 2026-10-14.

mini_descriptor.label: the-farm-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Organizes the pets (intelligent apps). His daily rounds keep every pet’s status and mood, the roster, the System Map and the profile README up to date, and list what needs Astra.

mini_descriptor.label: github-aquarium-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Swims through every public word on a GitHub account and flags document-control, blatant, organizational and systemic errors.

mini_descriptor.label: data-dealer-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Reports the health of Data Dealer, Astra’s large and important data project: its site, data, services and open work, so she sees at a glance what needs her.

mini_descriptor.label: api-fairy-ring-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Keeps notes about your API keys, never the keys themselves: where each lives and what uses it, which keys have gone stale, and which new keys to get. Lives in the corner of the Windows desktop.

mini_descriptor.label: unity-stable-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: A local Unity and VRChat desk with avatar plans, 26 dated tools, open-arch audits, concise summaries and evidenced execution history.

mini_descriptor.label: python-jungle-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: A Python practice desk with short output exercises, answer checks and saved progress alongside the original lessons.

mini_descriptor.label: ai-astra-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Watches the health of VRChat AI Astra, both while she runs and while she is being worked on offline, so problems show up before a session.

mini_descriptor.label: the-nectar-nest-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Personal health tracker: weight lifting by body group and sets, cardio, and pole plans. Your data stays on your PC and is never committed.

mini_descriptor.label: nest-egg-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Personal finance tracker across your bank, savings and investment accounts. It reads balances and never moves money.

mini_descriptor.label: mommys-green-room-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: A local planning room for Mommy's classes and events, with session details, readiness and notes. Calendar and Discord connections are planned.

mini_descriptor.label: paper-girl-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Runs Paper Girl, a free science discovery desk: real research, publisher explanations and fresh articles.

mini_descriptor.label: file-kingdom-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Organizes your files and finds systemic errors. Shows every mass change before making it, with undo.

mini_descriptor.label: discord-tower-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Opens the installed OpenAI and Anthropic Discord presence controls, with a manual setup checklist.

mini_descriptor.label: iced-out-iceberg-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Drafts and tracks portfolio updates locally. GitHub and LinkedIn connections are planned; publishing is manual.

mini_descriptor.label: bass-and-biscuits-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Saves and samples music found online for Ableton Live, and plans releases: the first album, DJ mixes and where each one is hosted. Ableton Live connections are planned.

mini_descriptor.label: halo-list-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Records code-review findings and next steps, then exports a Markdown worklist. Editor connections are planned.

mini_descriptor.label: am-i-a-ghost-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Watches the public Ghost Protocol website and checks Astra’s own security against its research: a personal cybersecurity checklist and the steps she has completed.

mini_descriptor.label: idea-perch-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Planned: periodically reviews OneNote for new project ideas and reminds Astra to start them.

mini_descriptor.label: audio-rescue-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: A small Windows desktop pet for restarting Voicemeeter's audio engine when audio needs repair. Its browser page explains how to open the installed app.

mini_descriptor.label: spoonfed-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Helps choose where to eat by spinning restaurant choices while respecting locked preferences and keeping favorite spots.

mini_descriptor.label: claude-dock-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Claude’s twin of ChatGPT’s BSOD desktop pet, in looks and in function: an orange face on the Windows desktop that shows Claude’s live status in a bubble and opens quick chat.

mini_descriptor.label: light-hive-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Plans and previews lighting scenes for every RGB light in the room: room lights, mouse pad, mouse, PC and keyboard. Sending scenes to the real lights is planned.

mini_descriptor.label: crypto-burrow-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Manages the cryptocurrency mining program on Astra’s PC and checks whether mining is worth the power.

mini_descriptor.label: mail-shell-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Organizes your mail: sorts it, cleans it up and deletes what you no longer need, always with your OK first. Connects to no mail account yet.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-25-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Keeps Windows, drivers and apps patched against security holes (its confirmed security role; the rest of its job is Astra’s to choose).

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-26-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Archives your favourite memes, especially from Discord, and will run a tool for making your own (not built yet). Your memes stay on your PC.

mini_descriptor.label: astra-s-gif-maker-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Makes GIFs in the browser.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-28-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Like API Fairy for backups: keeps track of when the last backup ran, where it is, and how to get to it.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-29-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: A white rabbit that preps and tracks VR software and performance.

programs.idea: Fuzz Factory (or Fuzzbois, the site he watches)

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-30-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Watches over the Fuzzbois website, which generates the Fuzzboi art, and shows its health with his mood. Mostly for fun: swap his look any time.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-31-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Watches the radios: unknown Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices nearby (its confirmed security role; the rest of its job is Astra’s to choose).

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-32-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Helps you manage your Elgato Stream Deck: what every button does, on every profile.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-33-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Manages Astra’s Meshtastic node: its place in the radio mesh, its health and its messages.

mini_descriptor.label: raspberry-pi-maker-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Keeps track of Astra’s Raspberry Pi projects and tells her which Pis need a backup or an OS update.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-35-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Not decided yet: Chat Rat’s job is Astra’s to choose.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-36-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Keeps Astra's pages working on iPhone, Android, iPad and desktop: shows a page on every device at once, checks it, tracks what each watched site still needs, and compares screenshots from two platforms.

programs.idea: Dubstep Gunsmith Shop, or something more clever (Astra, 2026-10-14)

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-37-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Astra’s catalog site for avatar gun effects and loadouts, made with Codex on 2026-10-12. Its source is only in Codex’s workspace on the PC, not on GitHub yet.

programs.idea: Astra's Infinite Pole (the world she looks after), or Pole Lookout

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-38-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Manages Astra's Infinite Pole.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-39-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Not decided yet: Procreate Panda’s job is Astra’s to choose.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-40-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Watches the agent and skill files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md) for every AI assistant and model, and tracks what changed, who changed it and why.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-41-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Monitors OSC packets and finds problems when several apps share channels to VRChat, OSCGoesBrrr and VRCFaceTracking.

mini_descriptor.label: nessis-ocean-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Piranesi Nessi's world caretaker for Piranesi House: its Unity project, preview website and use of shared Unity Unicorn tools. Runtime is planned.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-43-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Keeps track of all your saved pictures: where each one is, what it shows, and whether it is backed up.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-44-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Keeps track of all your saved videos, the same way Photo Dodo does for pictures: where each one is, what it shows, and whether it is backed up.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-45-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Organizes your closet (what you own and what goes together) and keeps your favourite places to shop.

mini_descriptor.label: iron-gates-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Security and approvals: human-facing approvals and security monitoring. Issues the grants and the short-lived agent keys; never approves her own.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-47-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Tasks: watches retries, stalled jobs and agent handoffs.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-48-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Observability: correlates logs, traces, health and failures.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-49-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Hosts: home servers, uptime, service health.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-50-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Containers: Docker health and authorized management.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-51-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Quality: tests and release verification.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-52-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: AI cost: model tokens, budgets and inference usage.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-53-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Network: packet loss, DNS, latency, routing.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-54-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Calendar: scheduling, conflicts and reminders.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-55-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Web and marketing operations: website QA and authorized browser work.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-56-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Data engineering: data integrity, schemas, pipelines.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-57-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Dependency updates: packages, compatibility, rollback prep.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-58-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Linux administration, SSH, systemd, packages.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-59-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Not decided yet: Stock Fox’s job is Astra’s to choose.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-60-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Passport/ID metadata, visa research and deadlines, encrypted.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-61-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Private travel diary and itineraries.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-62-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Bash, terminal scripting and guarded automation.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-63-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Processes, memory, drivers and OS internals.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-64-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Reverse proxies, TLS and secure private remote access.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-65-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Distributed services and orchestration.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-66-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: NAS, ZFS, snapshots and capacity health.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-67-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Authorized security assessment and remediation.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-68-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Authorized port and service exposure checks.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-69-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Encryption, keys, certificates and crypto education.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-70-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Incident timelines and log analysis.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-71-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Local model inventory, downloads and compatibility.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-72-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Inference benchmarks, GPU/VRAM, latency.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-73-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Agent experiments and tool-use evaluation.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-74-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Travel connectivity, VPN/tailnet and remote access.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-75-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Offline-first documents, caches and queued actions.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-76-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Cross-device sync and conflict resolution.

programs.idea: Vet Clinic / Vetted Vet: triage for the community vet-clinic (labels tickets, checks for leaked secrets, tests offered cures in isolation; never merges)

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-77-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Triages the vet-clinic: labels tickets, checks them for leaked secrets, and tests offered cures in isolation. Never merges anything.

mini_descriptor.label: the-police-station-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Runs The Police Station: watches every write and every agent key use, live; switches a tool, connection or key OFF (never ON); alerts Gatekeeper Goddess and Astra (L4); raises the alarm everywhere on a live break or a past breach.

mini_descriptor.label: ai-doghouse-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Keeps vetted research on AI agents, agentic harnesses, security and provenance, applies it to Astra’s PetOS, and writes the research paper.

mini_descriptor.label: the-recovery-room-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: After a shutdown, rebuilds the farm from the verified release, restores clean backups from before the incident, and restarts everything in the safe order.

mini_descriptor.label: pet-program-81-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Researches emerging cyber threats, CVEs, adversary tactics and public advisories, including lawful Tor-based intelligence sources when separately authorized. Shares defensive findings with File Master and security pets; distinct from Cipher Owl and Skill Scout.

programs.implementation_status: Core-hosted browser prototype: floor planning, local notes, exports and connected concept website. Native pet, L3 harness and Unity execution bridge are pending.

mini_descriptor.label: the-threshold-v1.0-mini-descriptor-v1.0
mini_descriptor.text: Door Dormouse manages Liminal Doors: floors, build choices, tools, Unity project metadata and preview website. Browser prototype; L3 and Unity execution are not connected.
